name: CAR PARTS PDX, INC.
old_description: For the best experience on our site, be sure to turn on Javascript in your browser.
about:
Car Parts PDX, Inc. operates from Portland, Oregon, serving the Pacific Northwest as a local source for automotive replacement parts. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed on its website.

The business stocks a broad catalog of collision and mechanical components, including bumpers in plastic and steel, body panels, door parts, mirrors, radiators, condensers, cooling fans, and lighting assemblies. It carries inventory for more than 45 major vehicle brands and presents its offerings through an online catalog that requires login for pricing.

Customers range from individual vehicle owners in the Portland metro area — including Clackamas and Vancouver, Washington — to independent repair shops seeking OEM-style replacement parts. Testimonials highlight quick turnaround and competitive pricing for both domestic and import models.

The company positions itself on fair pricing, local availability, and a wide brand selection as its primary differentiators in the aftermarket parts sector.
